name: Being Lonely
overview: Scripture acknowledges the pain of loneliness, beginning with God's declaration that it is not good for man to be alone, prompting Him to provide a suitable helper (Genesis 2:18). Yet, God promises His presence and comfort in times of solitude and abandonment, assuring believers that He will never forsake them (Deuteronomy 31:6; Psalms 27:10). The Lord strengthens and upholds those who feel isolated, healing broken hearts and providing courage through His faithful care (Psalms 23:4; Psalms 147:3; Isaiah 41:10).
